title: MineLinkX
description: MineLink v4.0.0 links Discord with Minecraft (Java & Bedrock), enabling chat sync, whitelist control, moderation (ban/tempban), appeals system, auto-whitelist, and full server management directly from Discord.
body:
🧠 **MineLinkX** is a powerful Discord ↔ Minecraft integration plugin designed for modern servers.
Manage your server, moderate players, sync chats, and control everything directly from Discord.

![## MineLinkX](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/356917e10b01260c06a6dd79bae1728b84066bff_0.webp)
---
Our discord Server for Help 

https://discord.gg/cYJvrZCFtV


## ⚙️ 🔹 Setup Guide

### 1️⃣ Install

* Plugin ko `plugins/` folder me daalo
* Server start karo → `config.yml` generate hoga

---

### 2️⃣ Config Setup (`config.yml`)

Fill karo:

* `token` → Discord Bot Token
* `guild-id` → Discord Server ID
* `review-channel-id` → Appeals review channel
* `approve-channel-id` → Approve/Deny logs
* `log-channel-id` → Minecraft → Discord logs
* `server-message-channel-id` → Discord → Minecraft messages
* `prefix` → `.` ya `!` (commands ke liye)
* `staff-roles` → Admin / Mod roles
* 
* ![config.yml](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/fbcb3c21339a9538b2012991009e50575599b63b.png)

💡 Same channel ID bhi use kar sakte ho (simple setup ke liye)


# Get token from 

![Discord Developer Portal](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/04d745c40541983b53994c64293d3ffe6ba73ccf_0.webp)
---

### 3️⃣ Restart

* Server restart karo
* Bot online hona chahiye

---

## 💬 🔹 Chat Bridge Setup

Create channel: `#mccchat`

```bash
.setmsgchannel #mccchat
```

👉 Discord → Minecraft chat

```bash
.mclog #mccchat
```

👉 Minecraft → Discord logs

---

## 🔨 🔹 Moderation Commands

* `.ban <player> [reason]`
* `.tempban <player> <1h30m> [reason]`
* `.unban <player>`
* `.kick <player> [reason]`
* `.history <player>`

⚡ All moderation directly from Discord

---

## 📜 🔹 Whitelist System

(Only if enabled in config)

* `.whitelist add <player>`
* `.whitelist remove <player>`
* `.whitelist list`
* `.whitelist reload`

### Bedrock Support

* `.bedrock add <gamertag>`
* `.bedrock remove <gamertag>`
* `.bedrock list`

---

## 📩 🔹 Appeals System

* `.appeal` → Start appeal
* `.approve <id> [note]`
* `.deny <id> [note]`
* `.panel` → Post appeal panel

💡 Auto whitelist on approve supported

---

## 📢 🔹 Server Control

* `.servermsg <message>` → Broadcast to Minecraft
* `.status` → Bot status
* `.mlhelp` → Help menu

---

## ⚡ 🔹 Key Features

* 🔗 Discord ↔ Minecraft real-time sync
* 🛡️ Full moderation system
* 📩 Built-in appeals system
* 👥 Whitelist + Bedrock support
* ⚙️ Easy setup & config
* 🚀 Works with Paper / Spigot / GeyserMC

---

## 💡 Recommended Setup

* `whitelist.enabled: true`
* `bedrock.enabled: true`
* `appeal.enabled: true`
* `auto-whitelist-on-approve: true`

---

## 🧠 Why MineLinkX?

✔️ No console needed
✔️ Control everything from Discord
✔️ Fast, modern, and powerful
✔️ Perfect for professional servers

---

🔥 **MineLinkX – Connect Discord to Minecraft like never before.**
